ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

travel_api

- delta10: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when all required parameters are derivable from state and user input, using 'comprehensive' as default type when contextually clear

- delta12: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately after successful booking using state-tracked booking IDs without requesting them
- delta13: Execute contact_customer_support immediately when users request support about existing bookings using state-tracked booking IDs without clarification loops

- delta16: Avoid empty responses - execute available tools immediately when all required parameters are derivable from state, using defaults for optional fields and ignoring informational price ranges
- delta17: Complete flight booking operations before attempting cancellation - verify booking exists in state before cancel_booking
- delta18: Execute register_credit_card immediately when all card details are provided in user input, without requesting booking IDs
- delta19: Avoid empty responses - always execute available tools when parameters are provided in initial user input
- delta2: Treat budget limits as configuration requirements, not just informational context
- delta20: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including travel date are available from previous turns without re-verification
- delta21: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters are available, skipping unnecessary verification steps and intermediate API calls
- delta22: Execute register_credit_card immediately when all card details are provided, without questioning unambiguous date formats
- delta23: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when all parameters are available, without intermediate confirmation requests or type verification
- delta24: Continue workflow execution with state-tracked parameters across all turns - execute available tools immediately without parameter re-requests
- delta25: Avoid empty responses in multi-turn conversations - execute available tools immediately using state-tracked parameters without clarification loops for informational data like price ranges
- delta26: Execute sequential operations using state-tracked booking IDs without requesting additional verification
- delta27: Use default values for optional parameters when executing tools rather than requesting additional verification
- delta28: Execute book_flight with available city parameters and access tokens without requesting unnecessary traveler verification details
- delta29: Avoid get_booking_history calls when executing sequential operations with available state-tracked parameters to prevent state disruption
- delta3: Maintain exact state structure matches for credit_card_list and booking_record fields
- delta30: Execute sequential operations immediately when user requests support without questioning the nature of issues or requesting additional details
- delta31: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including access_token are available from previous turns without re-requesting authentication
- delta32: Use state-tracked booking IDs for cancellation operations without requesting ticket IDs when available from previous successful bookings
- delta33: Execute retrieve_invoice directly with state-tracked insurance IDs without intermediate history lookups
- delta34: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters are available in initial user input without requesting additional confirmation
- delta35: Use state-tracked booking IDs from successful book_flight operations for retrieve_invoice without re-requesting them
- delta36: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately when user requests invoice details and booking ID is available from state, without questioning function availability
- delta37: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when insurance cost is specified and type is contextually established, without re-verifying insurance type details
- delta38: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when all traveler parameters are provided in initial user input without questioning format details
- delta39: Avoid empty responses in turn 0 - execute available tools immediately when user provides complete parameter sets
- delta4: Verify and maintain exact state field alignment after each tool call, including access_token, booking_record, and token metadata
- delta40: Avoid empty responses in multi-turn conversations - execute cancel_booking immediately when booking ID is available from state
- delta41: Execute compute_exchange_rate and set_budget_limit immediately when currency context and amounts are derivable from conversation state, avoiding clarification loops for ambiguous parameters
- delta42: Execute book_flight immediately when all required parameters are available, ignoring price ranges from cost queries that don't require explicit user selection
- delta43: Avoid clarification loops for support requests - execute contact_customer_support immediately with state-tracked booking IDs
- delta5: Use provided access codes directly for flight operations without questioning format or requesting additional authentication tokens
- delta6: Execute book_flight immediately when flight details, payment method, access token, budget, and travel class are derivable from state
- delta7: Only confirm operations after successful tool execution, not based on assumptions
- delta8: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when core traveler details are available, using provided parameters without questioning format completeness
- delta9: Use provided parameters as-is without questioning formats when all required fields are available

twitter_api
- delta1: Execute post_tweet directly when social sharing is requested - never call authenticate_twitter or posting_get_login_status even with explicit credentials
- delta10: Execute retweet and comment operations using state-tracked tweet IDs from previous post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs
- delta11: Execute post_tweet immediately when tweet content is specified - never request authentication, credentials, or tweet IDs, even when login details are explicitly mentioned
- delta12: For multi-turn tweet modifications, use comment_tweet and mention_tweet with original tweet ID - never post new tweets for content corrections
- delta13: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from successful post_tweet operations for retweet without re-requesting authentication or tweet IDs
- delta14: Never call posting_get_login_status for any social operations - execute post_tweet directly when content is specified
- delta2: Execute retweet and comment using state-tracked tweet IDs from post_tweet responses - never request manual tweet IDs or authentication
- delta3: Never request Twitter credentials, authentication, or login status - execute social operations directly without any login prompts
- delta4: Complete all multi-turn conversations by executing final social operations directly - never request credentials, authentication, or platform selection at any point
- delta5: Execute social operations directly without authentication calls - never call authenticate_twitter or posting_get_login_status when credentials are explicitly provided
- delta6: Execute social operations immediately when all parameters are available - never request platform selection or confirmation
- delta7: Use state-tracked tweet IDs from API responses for multi-turn operations - never hardcode tweet IDs like '1'
- delta8: In multi-turn scenarios, track tweet IDs from post_tweet responses and use comment/mention functions for modifications - never create new tweets for content updates
- delta9: Execute post_tweet immediately when social sharing is explicitly requested - never prompt for credentials or authentication
